name: autoresearch propose/execute/synthesize/reviewer decide(needs_clarification) → coordinator (lineage anchor)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack recovery rule — RUN-ENTITY-DESCENDED branch (ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a anchor split, sibling of rule 10). Fires when autoresearch-propose (no viable hypothesis / plateau soft-stop), autoresearch-execute (sandbox catastrophic failure), autoresearch-synthesize (run state structurally inconsistent), or reviewer-autoresearch (artifact structurally malformed) terminates with decide(action=needs_clarification). Spawns a fresh coordinator (allow-list respond_direct / ask_user) to deliver the situation to the user.

ANCHOR (lineage.run-loop-entity-id, threaded → agent-run/06): these roles descend through the run-entity-fired iteration driver (rule 05 threads run-loop-entity-id into propose/synthesize; rule 03 carries it to execute; rule 07 to reviewer). They carry NO bare agent.run (the run entity has none for the inherit path), so the coordinator this rule spawns would inherit NO run anchor — leaving a silent executing-zombie if it failed. So we THREAD related_loops[run-loop-entity-id] = $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id onto the coordinator; a failure then routes to agent-run/06 (the lineage branch). The length_gt 0 fence guarantees the thread source resolves (defends the go-reviewer C1 garbage-literal-subject class) and makes this mutually exclusive with rule 10 (baseline, agent.run.entity_id).

Mirrors run-failed rule 13 (the descended-roles run-failed branch), scoped to the recovery-coordinator spawn instead of the run-outcome stamp.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
An autoresearch role at loop $entity.instance terminated with decide(action=needs_clarification). The role's reason field describes the framing or environment gap that blocked it.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read the rejecting role's reason + retry_hint.

Iteration 2 — your job is to deliver the situation to the user — either as a question (ask_user) when the gap is something the user can fix in one round-trip, or as a status (respond_direct) when the gap is structural and the user should see the partial-progress story. Examples:

- Baseline rejected because metric_parser could not extract a number from stdout → ask_user with a specific question about the expected output format.
- Propose rejected because the surface is too narrow and the journal shows plateau → respond_direct explaining the run reached its natural stopping point under the current surface; suggest a wider surface for a follow-up run.
- Execute rejected because the sandbox was unreachable → respond_direct describing the environment failure; this is not a question for the user, it's an operator-side issue.

Call decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<status prose>") OR decide(action="ask_user", reason="<question prose>"). Both are published on the user-response bus.

metadata.anchor_disposition: anchor_threaded (TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage) — threads run-loop-entity-id onto the woken coordinator so its involuntary failure routes to agent-run/06 (the lineage branch). Closes the deferred_4b zombie hole for the descended autoresearch roles.
metadata.split_rationale: Sibling of rule 10 (baseline, anchor_inherit). Split on the firing role's anchor: baseline carries agent.run.entity_id (inherit); propose/execute/synthesize/reviewer carry only lineage.run-loop-entity-id (thread). Same baseline-vs-descended asymmetry as run-failed rules 12 vs 13.
metadata.anchor_fence: lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0 — mutually exclusive with rule 10 (baseline, no lineage), and guarantees the threaded source resolves (C1 garbage-literal-subject defense).
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity caveat applies (research pack's 05 metadata explains in detail). Practical effect under the current rule engine: bound is informational; each needs_clarification is a fresh entity.
metadata.includes_execute: Unlike run-failed rule 13 (which excludes autoresearch-execute as a BUDGETED loop-failure routed through rule 04b), this rule INCLUDES autoresearch-execute: a VOLUNTARY decide(needs_clarification) from execute (sandbox unreachable) is an escalation, not a budgeted measurement failure, and must reach the user.
